education.summary: The capacitor shunts high frequencies to ground, so fast changes are attenuated and slow ones pass.
objectives: Relate the time constant to the step response
education.theory: fc = 1 / (2πRC) and τ = RC: after one time constant the output has reached 63 % of a step.
questions: What is the cut-off frequency here?
How long does the output take to reach 95 % of a step?
